prose_vector_decorations.review: Source-bound English prose underline and corresponding Korean emphasis reviewed. Pin the exact original source hash/path/English GIDs and baseline; preserve original construction bytes, black fill/paint, y and thickness. Only the prose decoration receives explicit horizontal scale/translation to cover the actual emitted Korean word/phrase ink (plus explicitly declared unchanged native numeral/notation). Mathematical rules, table borders and other figure paths retain the independent1e-7 coordinate check.
prose_vector_decorations.previous_review_before_full_phrase_fit: Source-bound underline and its Korean counterpart reviewed; exact original vector program, colour, physical width and vertical coordinates remain unchanged; only horizontal placement follows the corresponding Korean emphasis.

font_policy: IChO2019 native Latin/math font dictionaries and glyph programs remain unchanged. Korean prose uses Noto CJK serif/sans/bold source-style roles, source italic angles and exact source physical point sizes/baselines.

new_korean_font_stream_compression.scope: Only new KO_Natural font resources; original source font/image/content streams untouched.

collision_metric_scope: Protected original math/figures/text ink; the separately verified original prose underline contacts are reported explicitly.

actual_prose_underline_coverage_and_styl.scope: Actual emitted first glyph of every Korean prose word verifies the real PDF shear/font GID and original physical point/baseline. Every emphasized glyph curve is independently read from actual output font programs under actual PDF matrices; source-English prose underline x extents must cover exactly the emitted phrase ink. Native source/math programs and coordinate checks are unchanged.

actual_new_korean_inter_row_ink_audit.method: Exact embedded subset buffers paint glyphs at full-precision positions and angles, original point sizes and baselines; every adjacent row pair plus nonadjacent pairs below1.1em tested at2x threshold220. Cache each row over the union of exact pair clips on the unchanged global pixel grid.
